text: Once upon a time a little fox found a red ball in the grass and rolled it to his sister.
Lily dropped the cup, so it broke, and she felt sad. She told her mom and they cleaned it up.
Tom wanted to fly a kite. The wind was strong, so the kite went high above the trees.
The cat sat on the mat and watched the bird. The bird flew away and the cat went to sleep.
Mia shared her apples with her friends because sharing made them all happy.
A small boat floated on the lake. The boy pulled it back with a string and laughed.
It started to rain, so they ran inside. They drank cocoa and read a book together.
The puppy chased its tail in a circle until it got dizzy and sat down.
Grandpa planted seeds in the garden. In the spring, green shoots came up from the dirt.
Sam could not find his hat. It was under the bed, next to a dusty old shoe.
The moon was bright and the owls called. The children closed their eyes and dreamed.
Anna baked bread. The kitchen smelled warm, and everyone asked for a slice with butter.
A frog jumped from the log into the pond with a splash. The ducks swam the other way.
Ben said sorry after he bumped his sister. She smiled and they built a tower of blocks.
The train went over the bridge and into the tunnel. Then it came out into the sun.
She put on her coat because it was cold. Then she walked to school with her red bag.
The dog waited by the door. When the girl came home, it wagged its tail and barked.
They made a snowman with a carrot nose. Later the sun came out and the snowman got small.
The bees flew from flower to flower. They were busy, and the garden was full of sound.
At night the town was quiet. Only the river made a soft sound as it moved past the mill.
